howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: From search to shipment — the path to sourcing directly from Chinese factories.
howItWorks.step1Body: Explore Chinese factories by product category or industrial cluster. Filter by certifications, OEM support and more.
howItWorks.step2Body: Every factory profile includes a direct email and WhatsApp. Reach the factory yourself — no middleman, no hidden fees.
howItWorks.step3Body: Request samples, arrange a factory visit or third-party audit, agree on terms, then place your order with confidence.
howItWorks.factoriesBody: List your factory for free and reach international buyers searching for your products every day.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: Beyond the directory — hands-on support for international buyers sourcing in China.
services.matchBody: Tell us your product, budget and MOQ — we shortlist suitable factories from verified industrial clusters.
services.auditBody: We accompany you on factory visits or run independent checks: capacity, quality system, business license and background.
services.interpBody: Mandarin interpreters for meetings, calls and negotiations, plus business document translation.
services.qcBody: During-production and pre-shipment inspections with photo reports, so defects are caught before goods leave the factory.
services.logBody: Coordination of sea, rail and air freight, export paperwork and consolidation from multiple suppliers.
services.afterBody: We help you raise claims, arrange replacements and protect your interests after the order is placed.
services.ctaBody: Email us your requirements and we will reply within one business day.
